alt: 旅客被大風吹翻雨傘、行李箱傾倒，衣物和紙張散落在車站地面。
scene_prompt: 狼狽不堪 means being in a very awkward, exhausted and difficult predicament. At a modern train terminal in a sudden rain gust, a tired commuter's umbrella has turned inside out, suitcase wheel has broken and suitcase tips with a few clothes and papers spilling out. The commuter looks overwhelmed and unsure which of two corridors to take, damp and disheveled but unhurt. Nearby people offer a kind hand. Make the predicament clear and gently humorous, not humiliating. Natural anatomy, exactly two arms and legs each, hands interact plausibly with umbrella and luggage, suitcase rests on floor, broken wheel visible, no floating belongings, sensible perspective.
